design.split: doi (fold assignment taken from the OOF store, not re-split)

arms.ligand_both: existing tree OOF, ligand + metal + cell
arms.knn: Tanimoto kNN over Morgan r=2 2048 bits, k=25

caveats: The DOI split here has tree OOF only; there is no GNN OOF on this split, so this is not the same blend as msrs_hybrid.json (which is fragment/canonical).
The kNN arm is fitted on the same rows it predicts within a fold, using only the other four folds' labels; the fold assignment is DOI-grouped, so no paper contributes to its own prediction.
stack2/stack3 are fitted on the other four folds, which is standard stacking but still mildly optimistic relative to a fully nested protocol.
